programme.desc: A story that will entangle Platanus residents in an adventure that will have it all. Love, intrigue, passions, but above all laughter! / Μια ιστορία που θα μπλέξει τους μόνιμους κατοίκους του Πλατάνου σε μια περιπέτεια που θα τα έχει όλα. Έρωτες, ίντριγκες, πάθη, αλλά πάνω απ όλα γέλιο!

programme.title: Mediterranean (E) / Μεσόγειος (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Marseille. The show travels to one of the most important and historic ports in the Mediterranean to meet the leading vocal band Lo Cor de Las Plana, Sirventes, Gari Greu of Massilia Sound System, Ressegna and other musicians. / Επεισόδιο: Μασσαλία. Η εκπομπή ταξιδεύει σε ένα από τα σημαντικότερα και πιο ιστορικά λιμάνια της Μεσογείου για να συναντήσει το κορυφαίο φωνητικό συγκρότημα Lo Cor de las Plana, τους Sirventes, τον Gari Greu των Massilia Sound System, τους Ressegna και άλλους μουσικούς.

programme.title: Football: Malta - Greece (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Μάλτα - Ελλάδα (Ζ)
programme.desc: UEFA European Championship K-21 2027. Qualifiers. The 26th edition of the K-21 European Championship will take place in Albania and Serbia. The final is 16 teams with eligible players born after January 1, 2004. / UEFA Ευρωπαϊκό Πρωτάθλημα Κ-21 2027. Προκριματικά. Η 26η έκδοση του Ευρωπαϊκού Πρωταθλήματος Κ-21 θα πραγματοποιηθεί στην Αλβανία και τη Σερβία. Στην τελική φάση συμμετέχουν 16 ομάδες με επιλέξιμους παίκτες που γεννήθηκαν μετά την 1η Ιανουαρίου 2004.

programme.title: Gilda / Τζίλντα
programme.desc: Johnny goes to work for Balin Mantson, owner of an illegal casino. Everything goes well until Manson returns from a trip with his young wife, Gilda ... A woman from Johnny's past. (120) / Ο Τζόνι πηγαίνει να εργαστεί για τον Μπάλιν Μάντσον, ιδιοκτήτη ενός παράνομου καζίνο. Όλα πάνε καλά μέχρι τη στιγμή που ο Μάντσον επιστρέφει από κάποιο ταξίδι μαζί με τη νέα γυναίκα του, την Τζίλντα... μια γυναίκα από το παρελθόν του Τζόνι. (120)

programme.title: The double aspect of the revolution / Η Διπλή Όψη της Επανάστασης
programme.desc: PREMIERE. In the aftermath of the Islamic Revolution in Iran, a wealthy Jewish family is being prosecuted by the revolutionaries and is forced to abandon everything and escape the country in a film based on true events. (110) / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Στον απόηχο της ισλαμικής επανάστασης στο Ιράν, μια ευκατάστατη εβραϊκή οικογένεια διώκεται από τους επαναστάτες και αναγκάζεται να εγκαταλείψει τα πάντα και να δραπετεύσει από τη χώρα, σε μια ταινία βασισμένη σε αληθινά γεγονότα. (110)

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: In the summer I first noticed the sun set. Summer of 2000. A boy arrives in a seaside village. He is accompanied by the figure of an alienated old woman. When one day he is no longer there, the boy will turn his gaze to the sunlight. / Το Καλοκαίρι που Παρατήρησα για Πρώτη Φορά τον Ήλιο να Δύει. Καλοκαίρι του 2000. Ένα αγόρι φθάνει σ ένα παραθαλάσσιο χωριό. Τον συντροφεύει η φιγούρα μιας αποξενωμένης ηλικιωμένης γυναίκας. Όταν μια μέρα αυτή δε θα βρίσκεται πια εκεί, το αγόρι θα στρέψει το βλέμμα του στο φως του ηλίου που δύει.

programme.title: Greek events K8 E12 (E) / Ελλήνων Δρώμενα Κ8 Ε12 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kalymnos, land and sea. Kalymnos' great sponge history prevented its other side, the other, the other, where human activity preceded the seafood, establishing and creating its own map of local experiences. / Επεισόδιο: Κάλυμνος, Στεριά και Θάλασσα. Η μεγάλη σφουγγαράδικη ιστορία της Καλύμνου, εμπόδισε να γίνει γνωστή η άλλη όψη της, η στεριανή, όπου εκεί η ανθρώπινη δραστηριότητα προπορεύτηκε της θαλασσινής, θεμελιώνοντας και δημιουργώντας τον δικό της χάρτη των τοπικών βιωμάτων.

programme.title: Islands on the edge E1 (e) / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Telendos. Telendos, a islet west of Kalymnos, eighteen miles from Turkey. Through the stories of its inhabitants we learn that, although life in Telendo is not easy, they are finally where they would like it to be. / Επεισόδιο: Τέλενδος. Τέλενδος, ένα νησάκι δυτικά της Καλύμνου, δεκαοκτώ μίλια από την Τουρκία. Μέσα από τις ιστορίες των κατοίκων της μαθαίνουμε πως, αν και η ζωή στην Τέλενδο δεν είναι εύκολη, τελικά βρίσκονται εκεί ακριβώς που θα ήθελαν να είναι.

programme.title: Sunday in the village again (e) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kastaniani Konitsa. Brand new idea on traditional show. The village, the people who inhabit it, their lives, the way they reproduce their traditions, everything they have achieved in time and everything they dream. / Επεισόδιο: Καστάνιανη Κόνιτσας. Ολοκαίνουργια ιδέα πάνω στην παραδοσιακή εκπομπή. Πρωταγωνιστής παραμένει το χωριό, οι άνθρωποι που το κατοικούν, οι ζωές τους, ο τρόπος που αναπαράγουν τις παραδόσεις τους, όλα όσα έχουν πετύχει μέσα στο χρόνο κι όλα όσα ονειρεύονται.

programme.title: Mozart in Paris (E) / Ο Μότσαρτ στο Παρίσι (Ε)
programme.desc: Concert dedicated to Mozart in the gardens of the Sully Hotel, Paris. The Paris Room Orchestra and its music director, the famous German pianist and conductor Lars Vogt, celebrate an afternoon full of Mozart. / Συναυλία αφιερωμένη στον Μότσαρτ στους κήπους του ξενοδοχείου Sully, στο Παρίσι. Η Ορχήστρα Δωματίου του Παρισιού και ο μουσικός διευθυντής της, ο διάσημος Γερμανός πιανίστας και μαέστρος Lars Vogt, γιορτάζουν ένα απόγευμα γεμάτο Μότσαρτ.

programme.title: Herbs, Earth Fruit (E) / Βότανα, Καρποί της Γης (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Innovation and tradition in the Nestos plain. Valia discovers the role of geothermal in the cultivation of asparagus and herbs and meets the inventive Theodore who cultivates sesame seeds. / Επεισόδιο: Καινοτομία and Παράδοση στην Πεδιάδα του Νέστου. Η Βάλια ανακαλύπτει τον ρόλο της γεωθερμίας στην καλλιέργεια σπαραγγιού και βοτάνων και συναντά τον ευρηματικό Θόδωρο που καλλιεργεί σουσάμι.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of the Sea (E) / Η Αδελφότητα της Θάλασσας (Ε)
programme.desc: The Brotherhood of the Sea, or otherwise a Verac Lagooy, is a race of nomads living on the island of Ko Lipi in Thailand. They are fishermen, divers and explorers and live on the sea. Many die because of primitive fishing techniques. / Η Αδελφότητα της Θάλασσας, ή αλλιώς Ουράκ Λαγουόι, είναι φυλή νομάδων που ζει στο νησί Κο Λίπε στην Ταϊλάνδη. Είναι ψαράδες, δύτες και εξερευνητές και ζουν στην ακροθαλασσιά. Πολλοί πεθαίνουν εξαιτίας των πρωτόγονων τεχνικών ψαρέματος.

programme.title: Pilgrims and hikers K2 E2 (E) / Προσκυνητές και Πεζοπόροι Κ2 Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Camino de Costa Rica. Our protagonists start a tropical adventure from the Caribbean Sea to the Pacific Ocean, crossing the jungle. They meet native communities and rural cities, enjoy wildlife and traditional lifestyle. / Επεισόδιο: Καμίνο ντε Κόστα Ρίκα. Οι πρωταγωνιστές μας ξεκινάνε μια τροπική περιπέτεια από την Καραϊβική Θάλασσα ως τον Ειρηνικό Ωκεανό, διασχίζοντας τη ζούγκλα. Συναντούν κοινότητες ιθαγενών και αγροτικές πόλεις, απολαμβάνουν την άγρια ζωή και τον παραδοσιακό τρόπο ζωής.

programme.desc: Skyros Anemosa. Skyros, though an island, is a special case on our music and dance map. Έχει διασπαστεί από τα χτυπήματα της αστυνομίας. Οι σημερινοί έμποροι έχουν μεταλλαχθεί, η μη ορατότητα, είναι το ατού τους.

programme.title: The Aegean of our lives E3 (e) / Το Αιγαίο της Ζωής μας Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: What was given and stayed. ERT3 records the course and work of the Aegean Group 130 volunteers, crossing the waves to provide meaningful care and hope to residents of the islands through medical, informative, construction, educational and cultural activities. / Επεισόδιο: Ό,τι Δόθηκε και Έμεινε. Η ΕΡΤ3 καταγράφει την πορεία και το έργο των 130 εθελοντών της Ομάδας Αιγαίου, που διασχίζουν τα κύματα για να δώσουν ουσιαστική φροντίδα και ελπίδα στους κατοίκους των ακριτικών νησιών μέσα από ιατρικές, ενημερωτικές, κατασκευαστικές, εκπαιδευτικές και πολιτιστικές δράσεις.

programme.title: Inside C2 E3 (E) / Εντός Κάδρου Κ2 Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Scientific research. The new weekly show comes to stand and give time and weight to issues that concern Greek society. Μέσα από διηγήσεις ανθρώπων, τίθενται τα ερωτήματα που καλούνται στη συνέχεια να απαντήσουν οι ειδικοί.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Zlatibor - Vojvodina / Košarka - KLS: Zlatibor - Vojvodina
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G4 / Košarka - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G4
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: FMP - Dubai / Košarka - ABA liga: FMP - Dubai
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Borac - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Chat by coffee / Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Dynasty / Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake devotes a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.desc: Women's Bundesliga is starting a new season in which fans can rejoice in top football and tense duels. programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Augsburg - B. Munich, Bundesliga 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Augsburg - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/26
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/26 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/26
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Video night / Videonoč
We predict / Napovedujemo
Musical Matinee / Glasbena matineja

Imago Sloveniae Festival 2013: Vocal Academy Ljubljana, conductor Stojan Kuret, recording from the Šentjakob Church in Ljubljana, Mon. / Festival Imago Sloveniae 2013: Vokalna akademija Ljubljana, dirigent Stojan Kuret, posnetek iz Šentjakobske cerkve v Ljubljani, pon.
programme.desc: R: Šuligoj Jaka ... Vocal Academy Ljubljana was founded in September 2008 and consists of sixteen to twenty experienced choir singers from all over Slovenia. In 2009, at the 57th International Choir Competition in Arezzo, Italy, she convincingly won in all four registered categories and won the grand prize. The latter led the Vocal Academy of Ljubljana as the first male choir in history on May 15, 2010, to win the competition for the Grand Prix of Europe. In 2011, they also received the prestigious Guidoneum Award 2011 in Arezzo for outstanding achievements and contribution to the development of choir music on a global scale. The persistent and dedicated artistic director and conductor of the singers group is Maestro Stojan Kuret. Under his leadership, home audiences presented themselves in the filled church of St. Jacob in Ljubljana. They invited guest musician, pianist Mojca Prus and soprano Martina Burger to their performance. / R: Šuligoj Jaka... Vokalna akademija Ljubljana je bila ustanovljena septembra 2008 in jo sestavlja od šestnajst do dvajset izkušenih zborovskih pevcev iz vse Slovenije. Leta 2009 je na 57. mednarodnem zborovskem tekmovanju v Arezzu v Italiji prepričljivo zmagala v vseh štirih prijavljenih kategorijah ter osvojila še veliko nagrado. Slednja je Vokalno akademijo Ljubljana kot prvi moški zbor v zgodovini 15. maja 2010 v Varni popeljala še do zmage na Tekmovanju za veliko nagrado Evrope. Leta 2011 so v Arezzu prejeli še prestižno nagrado Guidoneum award 2011 za izjemne dosežke in doprinos k razvoju zborovske glasbe v svetovnem merilu. Vztrajni in predani umetniški vodja in dirigent skupine pevcev je maestro Stojan Kuret. Pod njegovim vodstvom so se domači publiki predstavili v napolnjeni Cerkvi sv. Jakoba v Ljubljani. Na svoj nastop so povabili gostujoči glasbenici, pianistko Mojco Prus in sopranistko Martino Burger.

programme.sub-title: The Wonders Of Europe / Leurope Des Merveilles Ii.; Druga sezona dokumentarne serije Čudesa Evrope razkriva zgodovino štirih edinstvenih evropskih znamenitosti: Eifflovega stolpa, firenške stolnice, rimskega Panteona in veličastnega dvorca Schonbrunn na
programme.desc: Part 1: The Eiffel Tower, the engineering challenge, presentes the history of the famous Eiffel Tower, the symbol of Paris and France. It was built as a central attraction of the World Exhibition, which was held in Paris in 1889 to commemorate the centenary of the French Revolution. Stunning recordings and comments from experts reveal how, at that time, the fully incomprehensible idea of ​​building a more than 300 -meter -high iron tower, despite numerous criticisms and relentless attacks of powerful opponents, has recently grown a masterpiece, who has always written the name of Gustav Eiff. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Jean-Edouard Choppin. / 1. del: Eifflov stolp, inženirski izzivPrvi del predstavi zgodovino znamenitega Eifflovega stolpa, simbola Pariza in Francije. Zgrajen je bil kot osrednja zanimivost svetovne razstave, ki so jo leta 1889 v počastitev stoletnice francoske revolucije priredili v Parizu. Osupljivi posnetki in komentarji strokovnjakov razkrivajo, kako je iz drzne, za tisti čas popolnoma nepojmljive zamisli o gradnji več kot 300 metrov visokega železnega stolpa kljub številnim ostrim kritikam in neusmiljenim napadom močnih nasprotnikov nazadnje zrasla mojstrovina, ki je ime inženirja Gustava Eiffla za vedno zapisala v zgodovino.THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Jean-Edouard Choppin.

programme.title: Mouse who roared, British-American film, Mon. / Miš, ki je rjovela, britansko-ameriški film, pon.
programme.sub-title: The Mouse That Roared; Ob 100. obletnici rojstva Petra Sellersa
programme.desc: The fictional pocket alpine country Grand Fenwick finds herself on the verge of decaying when the American company takes her monopoly over her only export product, wine. The government is trying to plan: to predict the US war, and then immediately surrender and enjoy the generous American help. A small army in medieval armor lands in almost empty New York and accidentally receives a destructive nuclear bomb and its inventor under control. Instead of defeat, he finds himself in a situation where he can blackmail the world superpowers. During the diplomatic chaos, romance also emerges between the unaccepted commander and the scientist's daughter. A movie with insightful humor converts the logic of the Cold War and the policy of the superpower.8. In September, we celebrate the 100th anniversary of Peter Sellers (1925-1980), one of the most versatile and humorous British players. The master of transformation and the Akcente was famous with unforgettable roles in the series Pink Panther, in Satira Dr. Strangelov and in an unforgettable drama welcome, Mr. Chance. His ability to play several completely different characters in one movie is brilliantly illustrated by a comedy, which we play on Television Slovenia in the master's actor. Although it is a smaller movie in Sellers' career, we cannot avoid his hyper -pointing comedic game, as well as the humorous absurd scenario, such as today's comedies to miss ... Original title: The Mouse That Roard / British Film, 1959 / Director: Jack Arnold / Screenplay: Roger Macdougall, Stanley Mann, after Leonard Wibberley's novel / Starring: Peter Sellers, Jean Seberg, William Hartnell, David Kossooff, Leo Mckern. / Izmišljena žepna alpska državica Grand Fenwick se znajde na robu propada, ko ji ameriško podjetje spelje monopol nad njenim edinim izvoznim izdelkom, vinom. Vlada skuje načrt: napovedati vojno ZDA, nato pa se takoj predati in uživati v radodarni ameriški pomoči. Majhna vojska v srednjeveških oklepih pristane v skoraj praznem New Yorku ter po naključju dobi pod nadzor uničevalno jedrsko bombo in njenega izumitelja. Namesto poraza se znajde v položaju, ko lahko izsiljuje svetovne velesile. Med diplomatskim kaosom se poraja tudi romanca med nespretnim poveljnikom in znanstvenikovo hčerjo. Film s pronicljivim humorjem spreobrača logiko hladne vojne in politike velesil.8. septembra obeležujemo 100. obletnico rojstva Petra Sellersa (1925–1980), enega najbolj vsestranskih in duhovitih britanskih igralcev. Mojster preobrazb in akcentov je zaslovel z nepozabnimi vlogami v seriji Rožnati panter, v satiri Dr. Strangelove ter v nepozabni drami Dobrodošli, gospod Chance. Njegova sposobnost, da v enem filmu odigra več popolnoma različnih likov, sijajno ponazarja komedija, ki jo v priklon mojstrskemu igralcu predvajamo na Televiziji Slovenija. Čeravno gre za manjši film v Sellersovi karieri, se v njem ne moremo izogniti njegovi hiperprecizni komični igri, kot tudi ne duhovito absurdnemu scenariju, kakršne gre v današnjih komedijah nadvse pogrešati...Izvirni naslov: THE MOUSE THAT ROARED / Britanski film, 1959 / Režija: Jack Arnold / Scenarij: Roger MacDougall, Stanley Mann, po romanu Leonarda Wibberleyja / Igrajo: Peter Sellers, Jean Seberg, William Hartnell, David Kossoff, Leo McKern.

programme.desc: For over 55 years, Tomaž Domicelj has been part of the Slovenian music scene. He began his journey to Slovenian song in 1972 and became a recognized singer -songwriter in the following years. During the break of Slovenian song, he participated in the POP Workshop Festival, and also outside the music festivals, nose many musical hits, which are still alive today and are right to say that they have been fake. Singing tunes - from blues and romantic heart songs to punk and rapper -colored, even classically spiced music escapes, along with top arrangers, are characteristic of the creativity of Tomaž Domicelj. The insight, engagement, humor - sometimes ruble or black - domestic contemporary texts, which have been current decades after its creation, are a constant of the author who is surprised by forty -five years. The music, songwriter, composer, journalist, journalist, publisher and producer are all faces of Tomaž Domicelj. Soloists: Alenka Godec, Alfi Nipič, Anika Horvat, Damjana Golavšek, Dominik Kozaric, Gojmir Lešnjak - Gojc, Hamo, Helena Blagne, Jan Plestenjak, Lara Baruca, Marko Vozelj, Mitja Ferenc, Neisha, Nina Pušlar, Nina Strnad Franko, Tinkara Kovač, Tokac, Tomi Meglic Personal Guest: Tomaž Domiceljdirigent: Patrik Groblosymphonic Orchestra and Big Band RTV SLOVENIAN SHOP OF RTV SLOVENIA: Miša Molcreziser: Aljaž Bastič. / Tomaž Domicelj je že več kot 55 let del slovenske glasbene scene. V 60. letih prejšnjega stoletja je ustanovil kvartet Helioni, samostojno pot nadaljeval kot kitarist in skladatelj ter se v začetku 70. let uveljavil kot tekstopisec in pevec. Pot na Slovensko popevko je začel leta 1972 in v naslednjih letih postal priznan kantavtor. Med prekinitvijo Slovenske popevke je sodeloval na festivalu Pop delavnica in tudi zunaj glasbenih festivalov nizal številne glasbene uspešnice, ki so še danes žive in zanje upravičeno rečemo, da so ponarodele. Spevne melodije – od bluesa in romantičnih srčnih popevk do punkovsko in rapersko obarvanih, celo klasično začinjenih glasbenih eskapad, skupaj z vrhunskimi aranžerskimi sodelavci, so značilni za ustvarjalnost Tomaža Domicelja. Pronicljivost, angažiranost, humor – včasih bridek ali črn – domačna sodobna besedila, ki so aktualna še desetletja po nastanku, pa so stalnica avtorja, ki preseneča že dobrih petinpetdeset let.Glasbenik, pevec, tekstopisec, skladatelj, prevajalec, novinar, založnik in producent so vsi obrazi Tomaža Domicelja. programme.desc: In early September, from the healthiest and beautiful fruits of the peppers we picked up when the flowers were still, we pick up seeds. Mike Rowe and his team visit people with unusually dirty, hard, sometimes disgusting and sometimes dangerous jobs and show how important these often unpleasant work are. / Mike macht sich auf den Weg nach Pennsylvania und versucht sich in der Herstellung von Bologna, bevor er nach Alaska reist, um eine ganz besondere Toilette zu reparieren.Mike Rowe und sein Team besuchen Menschen mit ungewohnlich schmutzigen, harten, manchmal eklig-abstossenden und bisweilen auch gefahrlichen Jobs und zeigen, wie wichtig diese oft unangenehmen Arbeiten fur das Funktionieren unserer modernen Gesellschaft sind.

programme.title: The NATO - old friends, new fronts / Die Nato - Alte Freunde, neue Fronten
programme.desc: The documentary looks like the 75th anniversary of the NATO basis for the past, present and the future of NATO. Among other things, it illuminates that Article 5 of the North Atlantic Treaty is anything but binding, the necessary unanimity among the memberships is anything but safe and the necessary speed when loading troops and supplies in extreme cases is anything but secured. From where, in extreme cases, the relocation and supply is organized with supplies to the NATO headquarters in Brussel, where all political decisions are made. High-ranking reigning and former generals and security experts within NATO come up. Bundnis partner among themselves - not least for fear of a new strengthening Germany. And what were the consequences? And was there a promise after the collapse of the Soviet Union not to expand NATO to the east? And how is the relationship between Russia to NATO? / Der Dokumentarfilm blickt anlasslich des 75. Jahrestages der Nato-Grundung auf Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft der Nato. Sie beleuchtet unter anderem, dass Artikel 5 des Nordatlantikvertrags alles andere als bindend, die erforderliche Einstimmigkeit unter den Mitgliedslandern alles andere als sicher und die erforderliche Schnelligkeit bei der Verladung von Truppen und Nachschub im Extremfall alles andere als gesichert ist.Dabei begibt sich der Film auf eine Reise quer durch das Bundnisgebiet, vom estlandischen Tallinn, dem Standort des Cyber-Defence-Zentrums der Nato, uber Ulm, von wo aus im Extremfall die Truppenverlegung und die Versorgung mit Nachschub organisiert wird, bis zum Nato-Hauptquartier in Brussel, wo alle politischen Entscheidungen getroffen werden. Hochrangige amtierende und ehemalige Generale und Sicherheitsexperten innerhalb der Nato kommen zu Wort.Daruber hinaus blickt die Dokumentation mithilfe von internationalen Historikern zuruck auf die 75-jahrige Geschichte der Nato: Gegrundet nach den verheerenden Erfahrungen des Zweiten Weltkriegs, ging es den Architekten des Bundnisses nicht nur um Abschreckung gegenuber Feinden von aussen, sondern vor allem auch um die Sicherung des Friedens der Bundnispartner untereinander - nicht zuletzt aus Angst vor einem erneuten Erstarken Deutschlands.Wichtige Zeitzeugen wie Donald Trumps ehemaliger Sicherheitsberater John Bolton und Top-Diplomat Wolfgang Ischinger ordnen pragende Ereignisse in der jungeren Geschichte der Nato ein: Wie kurz war die USA 2018 tatsachlich davor, die Nato zu verlassen? Und was waren die Folgen gewesen? Und gab es nach dem Zerfall der Sowjetunion ein Versprechen, die Nato nicht nach Osten zu erweitern? Und wie ist das Verhaltnis von Russland zur Nato?

programme.title: TV or the resting on Waldbergstrasse / TV oder die Ruhestorung an der Waldbergstrasse
programme.desc: A police patrol fell into a whirlpool of fictional worlds, drawn by the TV consumption of a little boy. Frederic Siegel's animated film from 2025 was already shown at several festivals around the world. The original and imaginative action around the excessive media consumption of the small Diego shows in a humorous way what can happen when fiction becomes reality. / Eine Polizeipatrouille gerat in einen Strudel fiktiver Welten, ausgelost durch den TV-Konsum eines kleinen Jungen. Der Animationsfilm von Frederic Siegel aus dem Jahr 2025 wurde bereits an mehreren Festivals rund um den Globus gezeigt. Die originelle und fantasievolle Handlung rund um den exzessiven Medienkonsum des kleinen Diegos zeigt auf humorvolle Art, was passieren kann, wenn Fiktion Realitat wird.

programme.title: West Side Story / West Side Story
programme.desc: New York in the 1950s: The city government in Manhattan's slums can be torn down in large-scale Hauser to upgrade the quarters and build attractive house. The members of the “Jets” youth course meet on the empty flat. They are currently in the process of overlaping the huge drawing of a Puerto-Rican flag when their opponents, the “Sharks”, a Puerto-Rican group, appear and a guilder occurs. The "jets" see themselves as the "true" Americans and the Puerto Ricans as load-bearing immigrants who take away work and women. Bald is already the next confrontation. At a dance evening, the hostile gangs cease to overtake the dance flat. Maria is also there for her friend Anita. Although she is courted by Chino (Josh Andres Rivera), Maria will soon only have his eyes for Tony, but who belongs to the jets. But can a love over the boundaries of the youth course have a future? In 1957 Leonard Bernstein's musical over two youth ends of different ethnic origin in the New York slums, today it belongs to the most played musicals worldwide. As early as 1961, the fabric was filmed, at that time with Natalie Wood and Richard Beymer in the roles of Maria and Tony.steven Spielberg - known for large floats, be it in the sci -fi, in the adventure film or in the drama - dared to take a musical for the very first time with “West Side”. Critics were amazed that the old master did not move the material to the present, but rather made it even more realistic in his time, the 1950s. Nevertheless, Spielberg remains very faithful to the genre musical. People present the actors across the board, not least because they sing everything themselves. The debutant Rachel Zegler, who plays Maria, is outstanding. At her side, Ansel Elgort, Ariana Debose, Corey Stoll, Mike Faist, David Alvarez play among others. An actress deserves a special awareness: Rita Moreno played the role of Anita, Maria's best friend in “West Side Story” from 1961 under the direction of Jerome Robbins and Robert Wise. She plays forty years later at Spielberg Valentina, a older woman who once came from Puerto Rico and married a jet. The figure is only available at Spielberg.Srf two shows “West Side Story” exclusively in two -channel sound German/English. / New York in den 1950er-Jahren: Die Stadtregierung lasst in den Slums von Manhattan grossflachig Hauser abreissen, um die Viertel aufzuwerten und attraktive Wohnhauser zu errichten. Auf den leeren Flachen treffen sich die Mitglieder der Jugendgang «Jets». Gerade sind sie dabei, die riesige Zeichnung einer puerto-ricanischen Flagge zu ubermalen, als ihre Gegner, die «Sharks», eine puerto-ricanische Gruppe, auftauchen und es zu einer Schlagerei kommt. Die «Jets» sehen sich als die «wahren» Amerikaner und die Puerto-Ricaner als lastige Einwanderer, die ihnen Arbeitsplatze und Frauen wegnehmen.Bald steht schon die nachste Konfrontation an. Bei einem Tanzabend beaugen sich die verfeindeten Banden uber die Tanzflache hinweg. Auch Maria ist mir ihrer Freundin Anita da. Sie wird zwar von Chino (Josh Andres Rivera) umworben, doch Maria hat bald nur noch Augen fur Tony , der aber zu den Jets gehort. Doch kann eine Liebe uber die Grenzen der Jugendgangs eine Zukunft haben?1957 wurde Leonard Bernsteins Musical uber zwei Jugendgangs unterschiedlicher ethnischer Herkunft in den New Yorker Slums uraufgefuhrt, heute gehort es zu den am meisten gespielten Musicals weltweit. Bereits 1961 wurde der Stoff verfilmt, damals mit Natalie Wood und Richard Beymer in den Rollen von Maria und Tony.Steven Spielberg - bekannt fur grosse Gefuhle, sei es im Sci-Fi-, im Abenteuerfilm oder im Drama - wagte sich mit «West Side Story» zum allerersten Mal an ein Musical. Kritikerinnen und Kritiker zeigten sich erstaunt, dass der Altmeister den Stoff nicht etwa in die Gegenwart verlegte, sondern ihn vielmehr noch deutlicher in seiner Zeit, den 1950er-Jahren, verankerte, realistischer gestaltete. Gleichwohl bleibt Spielberg dem Genre Musical sehr treu.Seine Darsteller und Darstellerinnen uberzeugen auf der ganzen Linie, nicht zuletzt, weil sie alles selbst singen. Herausragend ist die Debutantin Rachel Zegler, die Maria spielt. An ihrer Seite spielen unter anderen Ansel Elgort, Ariana DeBose, Corey Stoll, Mike Faist, David Alvarez. Eine Schauspielerin verdient eine besondere Erwahnung: Rita Moreno spielte in «West Side Story» von 1961 unter der Regie von Jerome Robbins und Robert Wise die Rolle von Anita, Marias beste Freundin. Vierzig Jahre spater spielt sie bei Spielberg Valentina, eine altere Frau, die einst aus Puerto Rico gekommen ist und einen Jet geheiratet hat. Die Figur gibt es nur bei Spielberg.SRF zwei zeigt «West Side Story» exklusiv in Zweikanalton deutsch/englisch.

programme.title: Three weddings too much / Drei Hochzeiten zu viel
programme.desc: Ruth is persecuted by the bad luck. Neither at work nor when flirting can celebrate success. Then she has to find out that her three ex friends marry and all three invited Ruth. Maybe that's a good possibility of getting to know new people? Or even meet your dream man? / Ruth wird vom Pech verfolgt. Weder auf der Arbeit, noch beim Flirten kann sie Erfolge feiern. Dann muss sie feststellen, dass ihre drei Ex Freunde heiraten und alle drei haben Ruth eingeladen. Vielleicht ist das ja doch eine gute Moglichkeit, neue Menschen kennenzulernen? Oder sogar ihren Traummann zu treffen?

programme.title: The song of my heart / Der Song meines Herzens
programme.desc: Bonnie, the daughter of a well -known singer, opened a caf. Here she performs her poems in front of Gasten. The music superstar Ryder is a guest at the premiere. He immediately recognizes the potential of her words, but sees it more as inspiration for his songs. However, Bonnie had nothing to do with the music industry. Instead, she teaches Ryder to write down his feelings. While she helps him, they come closer and closer. / Bonnie, die Tochter eines bekannten Sangers, eroffnet ein Caf. Hier tragt sie ihre Gedichte vor Gasten vor. Bei der Premiere ist der Musik-Superstar Ryder zu Gast. Er erkennt sofort das Potential ihrer Worte, sieht sie jedoch eher als Inspiration fur seine Songs. Bonnie mochte jedoch nichts mit der Musikindustrie zu tun haben. Stattdessen lehrt sie Ryder, seine Gefuhle niederzuschreiben. Wahrend sie ihm dabei hilft, kommen sie sich immer naher.
